installSteps.text: Install FlightGear first if you have not already — Boeing 777 Series (777-200ER / 777-300ER) is an add-on and needs the base game.

The quickest route is the PlayBound Launcher: open FlightGear, find Boeing 777 Series (777-200ER / 777-300ER) in its mods list and press Install. The launcher downloads the official release and places it in the right folder for you.
To install it by hand, download the latest release archive from github.com/FlightGear-Community/777/releases.
Extract the archive into the "Aircraft/777" folder inside your FlightGear installation directory.
Start FlightGear and enable Boeing 777 Series (777-200ER / 777-300ER) from the in-game mods or add-ons menu. The download is roughly 180 MB.

faq.a: Yes. Boeing 777 Series (777-200ER / 777-300ER) is released under GPL-2.0-or-later and costs nothing. Neither it nor FlightGear has any paid content.

installSteps.text: Install FlightGear first if you have not already — Boeing 777 Series (777-200ER / 777-300ER) is an add-on and needs the base game.

The quickest route is the PlayBound Launcher: open FlightGear, find Boeing 777 Series (777-200ER / 777-300ER) in its mods list and press Install. The launcher downloads the official release and places it in the right folder for you.
To install it by hand, download the official 777.zip aircraft archive from FlightGear's FGAddon mirror.
Extract the ZIP into the Aircraft folder of your FlightGear installation. The archive already contains a 777 folder, so the result should be Aircraft/777, not Aircraft/777/777.
Start FlightGear and choose a Boeing 777 variant in the aircraft selector. The archive is roughly 218 MB.
